admin.subtitle: Kriraghor staff only. Two-factor authentication is required.
admin.totpSetupHelp: Add this key to Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy, then enter the code it shows.

vendor.intro: Manage your grounds, shop, gym or tournaments. Desks arrive with their modules.

errors.network: Can't reach Kriraghor. Check your connection.

fees.title: Fees and rules
fees.banner: Platform-wide. Saving needs your authenticator code and creates an audit entry. Fee and money-limit changes need a second master.
fees.readOnly: Read-only: only a master admin can change these.
fees.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
fees.codeHint: A fresh 6-digit code confirms it is you.
fees.savedApplied: Saved. The new values apply now.
fees.savedWaiting: Waiting for second approval. Another master must approve it.
fees.noteRequired: Add a short note to reject.

catalog.title: Esports catalogue
catalog.intro: Games, modes, maps and points tables used by tournaments. Rows are never deleted: deactivate hides them from pickers.
catalog.newVersionNote: Saving creates version {version}. Tournaments keep the version they started with.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every approval, fee, staff and payout decision, newest first. Rows cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.actionHint: One action, or several separated by commas
audit.chainPending: Not sealed yet (sealed within a minute)
audit.exportHelp: Exports the entries that match the current filters. Your authenticator code is needed, and the export itself is audited.
audit.historyEmpty: No audit entries for this item yet.

eventsOps.title: Events
eventsOps.intro: Domain events wait in the outbox until the relay delivers them to every consumer. Failed deliveries retry, then become dead letters you can replay.
eventsOps.lagAlert: Events have been waiting more than 60 seconds. Check that the worker is running.
eventsOps.name: Event
eventsOps.replayHelp: Deliver this event to {consumer} again. Your authenticator code is needed.

notifications.title: Updates
notifications.signedOut: Sign in to see your updates.

prefs.title: Notification settings
prefs.intro: Choose how we reach you for each kind of update.
prefs.locked: Required for your security and payments
prefs.notOffered: Not used for this kind of update
prefs.quietHoursHelp: Non-urgent texts and emails wait until morning.
prefs.languageHelp: Change it in your account settings.

finance.title: Finance
finance.intro: Payments, refunds, escrow, payouts, the ledger and reconciliation. Moving money needs your authenticator code; every action is in the audit log.
finance.noAccess: You need the view_payouts permission to see finance.
finance.loadFailed: This did not load. Try again.
finance.refundStarted: Refund started. The gateway confirms it in a few minutes.
finance.refundEscalated: Above your limit: a master must approve this refund.
finance.refundCodeHelp: This is above the staff limit. Enter a code from your authenticator app.
finance.decideHelp: Enter a code from your authenticator app.
finance.releaseTitle: Release up to {amount} to the payee
finance.releaseHelp: The payee gets the amount minus the fee snapshotted at the time of payment. Enter a code from your authenticator app.
finance.freezeHelp: A frozen hold cannot be released or refunded until it is unfrozen.
finance.unfreezeHelp: The hold goes back to its earlier state.
finance.reasonNeeded: Write a reason of at least 3 characters
finance.testIntro: A real payment through the gateway (simulator in dev), at most {max}. The payer pays from a link; the money waits in escrow until you release it here.

schedules.daily: Daily (pros, organisers, used gear, test charges)

confirmHelp.release: The money leaves the payee balance and waits to be sent to {account}.
confirmHelp.approve: Payouts above the threshold need two different masters. The second approval releases it.
confirmHelp.retry: The payout goes back to sending, to {account}.
confirmHelp.reveal: The full number is shown for 60 seconds and the view is recorded in the audit log.

payouts.riskHoldHint: Cleared on the Risk desk only.
payouts.revealHides: Hidden in {seconds} s. Do not write it down or share it.
payouts.sharedWallet: Also on {n} other {n, plural, one {user} other {users}}
payouts.verifyHelp: Only verify when the name on the wallet matches the NID legal name. A replacement account pauses payouts for 48 hours.
payouts.rejectHelp: The payee sees your note and can add another account.

check.file_reused: Photos not used by another account
check.nid_pending_elsewhere: NID not waiting on another account
check.uid_not_banned: UID is not on the ban list
check.uid_unique: UID isn't linked to another account
check.schedule_and_prizes: Schedule and prize table are valid
check.subsidy_at_minimum: Fees at the minimum fill cover the prizes
check.hours_and_rules_valid: Courts, hours and prices are valid
check.price_in_range: Base price within the allowed range
check.name_unique_in_area: No ground with a similar name nearby

kyc.revealReason: Why do you need the full number?
kyc.filesAudited: Opening a file is recorded in the audit log.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.intro: Everything waiting for review, oldest deadline first. Claim an item to review it: the lock holds while the pane is open. Tick every check before approving; give a reason for anything else.
moderation.noAccess: You need a review permission (approve_documents or approve_listings) to use the Moderation desk.
moderation.pick: Pick an item from the queue.
moderation.lockLost: Your lock ended. Claim the item again.
moderation.overrideHelp: Approving over a failing check needs your authenticator code. The check stays recorded as failed and the override is in the audit log.

problem.rubric: Tick every review check before approving.
problem.checks: A blocking check failed: ask for changes, reject, or (master) give an override reason.
problem.reasonText: This reason needs a note to the submitter.

moderation.overridden: Approved over a failing check by {name}: {reason}
moderation.reopenHelp: The item goes back to the queue with a new deadline. This is a critical audit entry.
moderation.reasonNeeded: Give a reason (3 characters or more).
moderation.overrideDialogHelp: Failing: {checks}. Enter your authenticator code to approve anyway.

esportsDesk.title: Tournaments
esportsDesk.intro: Run Kriraghor's PUBG Mobile and Free Fire tournaments: drafts go to the Moderation desk for a second person to approve. Then check players in, set the room, enter results, settle disputes and finalise the prizes.
esportsDesk.noAccess: You need the manage_esports or enter_results permission for this desk.
esportsDesk.pick: Pick a tournament on the left, or create one.

form.prizesHelp: Places 1, 2, 3 … in order. The table is locked once the tournament is approved and is guaranteed if it runs.
form.featured: Feature on the esports home page
form.badMoney: Enter amounts in taka, with at most 2 decimals.

esportsDesk.loadFailed: Couldn't load this. Refresh to try again.
esportsDesk.inReview: Waiting for a second staff member on the Moderation desk.
esportsDesk.cancelHelp: Every paid entry is refunded 100%. Enter your authenticator code to confirm.
esportsDesk.reasonNeeded: Give a reason of at least 5 characters.
esportsDesk.finaliseHelp: Prizes are credited to the winners' balances and the pool is settled in the ledger. Enter your authenticator code to confirm.

board.dqNote: Why disqualify this entry? (at least 5 characters; the prize is forfeited)

mstatusHelp.results_pending: Results are posted. Players can dispute until the window closes.
mstatusHelp.disputed: A dispute is open. Settle it on the Disputes tab.

room.rotated: New room pushed to checked-in players.

esportsDesk.cancelMatchReason: Why cancel this match? (at least 5 characters)

results.postConfirm: Post these results? Players are told and the dispute window opens.

disputes.rejectNote: Why is this dispute rejected? Players see this note.

groundsAdmin.title: Grounds
groundsAdmin.intro: Every ground and its owner. Reviews happen on the Moderation desk; here ops suspend a listing and masters restore or remove one.
groundsAdmin.noAccess: You need approve_listings or manage_users for this desk.

ask.remove: Why remove {name}? It cannot be undone.

places.intro: Areas, sports, facilities and surfaces that grounds and other listings use. Keys never change; deactivate instead of deleting. Grounds can be listed only in areas with grounds on.
places.groundsFlag: Grounds can be listed here (Dhaka only)

vendorBookings.gate: You need an active ground-owner account to see bookings.
vendorBookings.title: Bookings
vendorBookings.lead: Your ground's day: check players in, mark no-shows, extend, record what they pay at the venue, and add walk-ins.
vendorBookings.noLive: You have no live ground yet. Bookings start once a ground is approved.
vendorBookings.pickBooking: Choose a booking on the timeline.
vendorBookings.moneyNote: Check-in releases what the player paid online to you, minus the Kriraghor fee on the full price. Collect the rest at the venue and record it here.
vendorBookings.cancelHelp: The player gets everything they paid online back ({amount}). Cancellations count against your reliability unless the reason is the weather or a waterlogged ground.
vendorBookings.moveTitle: Move to another court (same time, same price)
vendorBookings.noTargets: No other court is free at this time.
vendorBookings.walkInTitle: Walk-in, paid in full at the counter
vendorBookings.name: Name or team
vendorBookings.walkInHelp: The Kriraghor fee on walk-ins is taken from your next payout.
vendorBookings.signIn: Sign in to see your bookings

vendorSchedule.title: Closures and series: {name}
vendorSchedule.closuresLead: Take courts out of play for repairs or an event, up to 90 days ahead. Move or cancel any bookings in that time first.
vendorSchedule.seriesLead: A regular team plays the same slot every week. Every week becomes a booking, paid at the venue.

bookingsAdmin.title: Bookings
bookingsAdmin.intro: Every ground booking with its money. The ledger trail shows the escrow release at check-in (fee on the full price), refunds and venue fees owed.
bookingsAdmin.noAccess: You need manage users or view payouts.
bookingsAdmin.cancelHelp: Everything paid online is refunded to the player. Enter your authenticator code.
bookingsAdmin.reasonNeeded: Give a reason of at least 5 characters.
